entries.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
entries.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi Rabban, wa bil-Islāmi dīnan, wa bi-Muḥammadin ﷺ Nabiyyan.
entries.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
Glory and praise be to Allah.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him.

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ · الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ · اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
entries.translation: Glory be to Allah · All praise is for Allah · Allah is the Greatest.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
entries.transliteration: Bismillāhilladhī lā yaḍurru ma‘asmihi shay’un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā’, wa Huwas-Samī‘ul-‘Alīm.
entries.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
entries.transliteration: Subḥānalladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn.
entries.translation: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished this by ourselves.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
entries.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli Muḥammad.
entries.translation: O Allah, send Your prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.

entries.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa, ‘alayhi tawakkaltu, wa Huwa Rabbul-‘Arshil-‘Aẓīm.
entries.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. None has the right to be worshipped except Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne.
